description: Creates Connector Card messages through Office 365 Connectors.

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: This array of objects is used to power the action links found at the bottom of the card.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Accent color used for branding or indicating status in the card.

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Contains a list of sections to display in the card. For more information see https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/outlook/actionable-messages/message-card-reference#section-fields.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: A string used for summarizing card content. This is the message subject. This is required if the text parameter is not populated.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The main text of the card. This is rendered below the sender information and optional title, And above any sections or actions present.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: A title for the Connector message. Shown at the top of the message.

parameters.name: webhook
parameters.description: The webhook URL is given to you when you create a new Connector.

examples:
- name: Create a simple Connector Card
  community.general.office_365_connector_card:
    webhook: https://outlook.office.com/webhook/GUID/IncomingWebhook/GUID/GUID
    text: 'Hello, World!'
